title: Maximum Consecutive Ones
description: Find the maximum number of consecutive 1s in the binary representation of a number.

data.text: Given a positive integer `N`, find the maximum number of consecutive `1`s in its binary representation.
Check each bit, track current and max consecutive 1s. O(log N) time.

data.title: Bit Scan O(log N)
data.content: Check each bit, track current and max consecutive 1s.

data.text: Use `n = n & (n-1)` to skip zeros, counting consecutive runs. O(k) where k is the number of set bits.

data.title: Brian Kernighan O(k)
data.content: Use n = n & (n-1) to skip zeros, counting consecutive runs.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: Brian Kernighan's approach iterates only over set bits, making it faster when zeros are frequent. Both approaches are O(log N) in the worst case.
